about: [JEngine]'s algorithms run as written, with every choice the paper leaves open fixed arbitrarily. Two claims per table. agreement: how close the reconstruction gets, with thresholds null until a change that computes these cells sets them to what it measured; after that a floor only rises and a ceiling only falls, each in its own commit naming the cells that moved. exact_given_inputs: given the inputs the paper's own numbers were produced from, all 120 cells reproduce exactly; the inputs are null until someone records them. Only candidates declaring board 'literal' are scored here, and the searched board's thresholds live in searched.json and are never read here.
